records.title: Duke University Karsh International Scholars Program
records.deadline_display: No separate application or scholarship deadline is published. The official page states "Simply apply to Duke University" and directs applicants to the Duke Financial Aid website; consideration therefore follows Duke University's own admission cycle.
records.application_period: Tied to Duke University's undergraduate admission cycle; the programme page publishes no separate window.

records.title: Excellence Scholarship for Bachelor Students (University of St.Gallen)
records.deadline_display: There is no public application deadline. The Advice Center for Study Funding identifies students with an outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year and invites them to apply; an application without an invitation is not possible.
records.application_period: Invitation-driven. Invitations are issued by the Advice Center for Study Funding to enrolled students with outstanding Assessment Year performance, and applications are submitted by those invitees only.

records.title: Starr International Foundation Scholarship (University of St.Gallen)
records.deadline_display: Applications for the 2026 Best Talents cohort were accepted until June 12, 2026. The application portal will reopen in November 2026 for the 2027 cohort application cycle.
records.application_period: Annual cohort cycle. The 2026 cohort window closed on June 12, 2026; the portal reopens in November 2026 for the 2027 cohort.

records.title: Erasmus Mundus EMCL Scholarship (European Master's in Clinical Linguistics)
University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Opening date 20 May 2026; closing date 12 August 2026 at midday. The page states 'Application status: Not currently open for applications'. The next round's dates are not published.
records.application_period: Annual. 2027 round: 20 May 2026 to 12 August 2026 at midday. The University notes applications 'will usually open around six weeks before the closing date'.
